project_type: Python stdlib HTTP server with vanilla JS/Three.js frontend - PV installation simulator
build_system: None - pure Python stdlib, no build step
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py' - all 413+ tests must pass. 2. Start server with python3 backend/main.py and test endpoint with curl.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure Python stdlib project. Run: python3 backend/main.py
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.9+ available.
contribution_requirements: Polish comments and variable names used throughout. Follow existing patterns.
key_patterns: Handlers return Tuple[int, dict] (status_code, response_body). Services are in backend/services/. Tests use unittest.TestCase with descriptive Polish names. Frontend uses direct X/Z position inputs that trigger 3D scene updates via events (budynekMoved, paneleMoved). Models in backend/models/. Existing services do pure computation (no network calls). The viewer.html already has bud-x, bud-z, panel-pos-x, panel-pos-z input fields. The 3D scene listens on 'input'/'change' events on those fields to move objects.
relevant_files: frontend/viewer.html (add distance inputs, API call, wire to existing X/Z fields)
directory_structure: backend/ (main.py, api/handlers.py, services/*.py, tests/test_*.py, models/, data/), frontend/ (viewer.html, js/, css/, pages/)
